title: 爱吃香蕉的珂珂
summary: 每小时选择一堆香蕉并最多吃 speed 根，求在 h 小时内吃完所有堆的最小整数速度。
insight: 所需小时数随速度单调不增；在一到最大堆大小上二分第一个满足 Σceil(pile/speed)<=h 的速度。
pitfalls: 累计小时数可提前超过 h

solutions.title: 二分最小可行速度
solutions.idea: 用单调可行性判断收缩速度区间。
steps: hours<=h 时 high=middle，否则 low=middle+1；返回 low

code.java: class Solution { public int minEatingSpeed(int[] piles,int h){int low=1,high=Arrays.stream(piles).max().getAsInt();while(low<high){int middle=low+(high-low)/2;long hours=0;for(int pile:piles)hours+=(pile+middle-1)/middle;if(hours<=h)high=middle;else low=middle+1;}return low;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minEatingSpeed(piles:IntArray,h:Int):Int{var low=1;var high=piles.maxOrNull()!!;while(low<high){val middle=low+(high-low)/2;var hours=0L;for(pile in piles)hours+=(pile+middle-1)/middle;if(hours<=h)high=middle else low=middle+1};return low} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minEatingSpeed(vector<int>& piles,int h){int low=1,high=*max_element(piles.begin(),piles.end());while(low<high){int middle=low+(high-low)/2;long long hours=0;for(int pile:piles)hours+=(pile+middle-1)/middle;if(hours<=h)high=middle;else low=middle+1;}return low;} };
